usage: inspector-gadget <node|dotnet> --code-root <dir> [-h|--help]

  <node|dotnet>   target ecosystem to inspect
                    node    TypeScript/Node project source (.d.ts always included)
                    dotnet  built .NET assemblies (NDepend-style)
  --code-root <dir>    project root to scan (required)
  -h, --help      show this help and exit

Writes codebase-dsm.html into <dir>; the page title is the root dir name.
